response.justification: While the candidate has strong full-stack and polyglot programming experience, there is no evidence of professional C++ development on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle database work, or any exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains — all of which are mandatory for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience with multiple languages and platforms
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices demonstrated across roles
Active open-source contributions and technical communication skills
concerns: No documented professional C++ experience on Windows platform
Lack of capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure
SQL experience listed but no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle usage in financial systems
